scheme_name: Scheme for Additional Interest Subsidy over and above RIPS 2024 and Reimbursement of Annual Credit Guarantee Fee
other_conditions: Interest subvention subsidy must have been approved under RIPS 2024
Beneficiary enterprise must be a One District One Product (ODOP) enterprise in its district
Enterprise may be owned by a woman entrepreneur
Enterprise must be involved in establishment of new MSMEs or expansion/diversification/modernization in Area Category 3 as defined in RIPS 2024
Young entrepreneurs can receive the subsidy for a loan amount up to ₹10 crore
Application must be submitted within six months of approval of interest subvention under RIPS 2024
Collateral‑free term loans (below ₹5 crore) under CGTMSE are eligible for reimbursement of 100% of annual guarantee fees
benefits_summary: Provides additional interest subsidy (up to 2% on top of RIPS 2024 rates) for eligible MSME projects and reimburses 100% of the annual credit guarantee fee for collateral‑free loans.
documents_required: Application form (Annexure 1.1) downloaded from the official website
Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
